name: Sonic.EXE: The Disaster 2D Redux
summary: Sonic.EXE: The Disaster 2D Redux is a deviated remake that reimagines the concept of "2D Sonic.EXE: The Disaster", heavily differing from the experience you may be already familiar with, but still having the things you've loved by being based on the 2D Remake's content with an exception of a huge amount of the new unique content made with love.
